name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-site
description: The FrontX site's own sections as four screens: home (what FrontX is, its parts, a worked first change and the UI kit), templates (an index and a page per template, built from each template's manifest), docs (getting started and a first change) and libs (the FrontX packages and short technical summaries of routing, microfrontends and the screen domain), with a shared content model whose pages, the home page included, are outlines of entries rendered by the blocks of template-site-blocks and also publish as plain text. Apply onto a project that already has template-shell, template-site-brand, template-kit-candidates and template-site-blocks applied; the screens appear in the shell's menu without further wiring.
